name: com.huawei.hms.hwid.internal.ui.activity.HwIdSignInHubActivity
description: This Huawei ID Activity is opened for an HMS Huawei ID sign-in request. It checks HMS Core availability, opens Huawei ID sign-in, and returns the account result to the app.
disableEffect: Apps that rely on Huawei ID sign-in can no longer complete that authentication flow.
